sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: A small moss of saline or brackish soils, including salt marshes, mudflats and muddy hollows. It forms tufts only a few millimetres tall and can also colonize salty road verges in winter.

sections.title: Leaves and capsules
sections.text: The leaves are about 1.5–2 mm long. The seta bears the capsule and can exceed 1 cm; this sporophyte is enlarged on the plate.

sections.title: Edibility
sections.text: No food use is documented for this moss.
